title: Listing Highlight: 68' Sunseeker Manhattan 2021 | YOUNG HEARTS
description: Explore this 2021 Sunseeker—a contemporary motoryacht combining refined design, advanced technology, and exceptional comfort for charter and ownership.
html:
Discover A Modern Motoryacht Built For Discerning Charterers And Buyers

The 2021 Sunseeker represents the pinnacle of modern yacht design, offering discerning buyers and charter enthusiasts a vessel that seamlessly blends aesthetic sophistication with practical cruising capability. Built after 2000 and positioned in the 60-plus-foot category, this motoryacht exemplifies the brand’s commitment to delivering vessels that perform as beautifully as they appear. Every detail reflects meticulous engineering and thoughtful design philosophy, from the flowing exterior lines to the carefully appointed interior spaces that invite relaxation and entertaining.

Sunseeker has long been recognized for creating yachts that balance performance with comfort, and this 2021 model continues that tradition with contemporary styling and modern amenities. The vessel’s hull design optimizes fuel efficiency while maintaining impressive sea-keeping characteristics, allowing owners and charterers to explore distant waters with confidence. The open-plan saloon features large windows that flood the interior with natural light, creating an airy atmosphere that connects guests with the surrounding seascape. Premium furnishings and carefully selected materials throughout the accommodation spaces establish an environment of understated luxury.

The master suite offers a private sanctuary with an ensuite head and generous storage, while guest cabins provide comfortable accommodations for family and friends. The galley is fully equipped with modern appliances, enabling the preparation of sophisticated meals while underway. The crew quarters ensure professional staff can operate the vessel efficiently, whether for charter operations or private ownership. Multiple entertainment spaces—from the flybridge to the aft deck—provide flexibility for various social configurations and activities.

Key Specifications: Length 60+ feet, Built 2021, Sunseeker brand, Charter-ready configuration with professional crew accommodations, Modern propulsion systems optimized for efficiency and performance, Advanced navigation and communication technology integrated throughout. Main Characteristics: Contemporary exterior styling with flowing lines, Open-plan interior design maximizing natural light, Premium materials and finishes throughout, Multiple entertainment and relaxation zones, Professional crew quarters supporting charter operations, Fuel-efficient propulsion systems.

The vessel’s technical systems represent the latest in marine engineering, with redundant safety equipment, modern stabilization technology, and integrated navigation systems that make extended cruising both safe and enjoyable. Climate control throughout maintains comfort in all conditions, while the electrical systems support modern conveniences without compromising reliability. The 2021 Sunseeker has been maintained to the highest standards, ensuring that every system operates at peak performance.
